spellcaster.name: Arcane Aim
spellcaster.description: +1 Precision on all spells that roll location /rank.

spellcaster.name: Draw Mana
spellcaster.description: Clear your mind of all thought and open yourself, drawing Mana from the local Mana Pool.  The ritual takes 10 minutes to perform, after which you roll all of your weaving dice. The total sum is your new Mana total. This mana does not stack with any mana you were previously holding. The ritual breaks concentration. 4 hour cooldown.

spellcaster.name: Arcane Mentality
spellcaster.description: Learn to permanently alter your mental state, allowing you to multitask the first phase of spell weaving. Grants 1 free action towards the weaving of any spell.  Passive skill.

spellcaster.name: Arcane Mindset
spellcaster.description: You can relearn any spell you have previously known in one minute of study with your notes.

spellcaster.name: Augmented Mentality
spellcaster.description: Learn to permanently alter your mental state, granting you one free action each round to use for concentration costs. Passive skill.

spellcaster.name: Careful Casting
spellcaster.description: You gain +1 on both weaving dice for every 3 actions spent on that attempt.

spellcaster.name: Chaos Mastery
spellcaster.description:
Determines the quality of your dice and maximum spell level when channeling the power of Chaos.

                          1d12 *only possible with Chaos Weaver

spellcaster.name: Chi Mastery
spellcaster.description:
Determines the quality of your dice and maximum spell level when channeling the power of Chi. Also provides extra Torso Hit points, which improve other locations in turn as normal.

spellcaster.description:
Determines the quality of your dice and maximum spell level when channeling Elemental powers.
                 Red Die Quality                                Maximum Spell Level

                          1d12 *only possible with Master Weaver

spellcaster.name: Enduring Inscriptions
spellcaster.description: The duration of all your Runes and Sigils is Quadrupled. (This stacks with other effects.)

spellcaster.name: Expanded Horizons
spellcaster.description: You may know 1 more spell/rank

spellcaster.name: Focused Will
spellcaster.description: Add half your Arcane Power to the difficulty of any attribute checks to resist your spells.

spellcaster.name: Hedge Wizard
spellcaster.description: You gain access to one school of magic without a proper understanding or control of the underlying powers. You can learn, weave (and hang) spells of the chosen school only, and of a spell level no higher than your rank in this skill. When weaving a single d4 is rolled.

spellcaster.name: Mana Mastery
spellcaster.description:
Rank 1: Reroll all 1s when generating mana.
Rank 2: Also reroll all 2s on d6s or larger when generating mana.
Rank 3: Also reroll all 3s on d8s or larger when generating mana.
Rank 4: Also reroll all 4s on d10s when generating mana.

spellcaster.name: Master Weaver
spellcaster.description: Your Weaving Dice are increased in Quality by 1. (d3 becomes d4, d4 becomes d6, etc until d10 becomes d12)

spellcaster.name: Order Mastery
spellcaster.description:
Determines the quality of your dice and maximum spell level when channeling the power of Order.  
                Black Die Quality   Total Extra Spells Known    Maximum Spell Level    
Rank 1:             1d3                               1                                        1
Rank 2:             1d4                               2                                        2
Rank 3:             1d4                               3                                        3 
Rank 4:             1d6                               4                                        4
Rank 5:             1d6                               5                                        5
Rank 6:             1d8                               6                                        6
Rank 7:             1d8                               7                                        7
Rank 8:             1d10                             8                                        8
Rank 9:             1d10                             9                                        9
                          1d12 *only possible with Master Weaver

spellcaster.name: Quick Counter
spellcaster.description: You may Weave Counterspells that are not hung using borrowed actions.

spellcaster.name: Re-Weaving
spellcaster.description: You gain +1 on both weaving dice if you are attempting a spell you failed to cast in the last minute.

spellcaster.name: Somatic Casting
spellcaster.description: You can hang spells leaving out only gestures, so that you can cast them without sound. Cannot be combined with Verbal Casting on any given spell.

spellcaster.name: Source Seizing
spellcaster.description: You can attempt to regain mana at any time by seizing the source directly. this is a dangerous and painfull process, but can be accomplished quickly. When the caster first seizes the source, concentration is broken and any mana held is lost. The caster takes 1 Torso damage every action that she continues the process. Each action the caster may attempt a Willpower check 25. If the caster passes three consecutive checks they regain mana in the same way as a successful meditation, and need not hold the source any longer. The caster may choose to let go of the source at any time.

spellcaster.name: Spell Thrower
spellcaster.description: Your throw stone ranges are increased by 20/40/60 when throwing Evoked or conjured balls. Stacks with Hurling.

spellcaster.name: Spellcrafting
spellcaster.description: +1 Spell Hook/rank

spellcaster.name: Summoner's Silence
spellcaster.description: Commands to your summoned creatures are given mentally, not verbally. This removes issues of range, and allows simple images to accompany commands for greater clarity.

spellcaster.name: Touch Master
spellcaster.description: Touch spells become ranged attacks with a 5 foot range. Add your Arcane Power to your Ranged Bonus.

spellcaster.name: Verbal Casting
spellcaster.description: You can hang spells leaving out only words, so that you can cast them without gestures. Cannot be combined with Somatic Casting on any given spell.

spellcaster.name: Will Mastery
spellcaster.description:
Determines the quality of your dice and maximum spell level when channeling the power of Will.
                BLue Die Quality   Total Extra Spell Hooks     Maximum Spell Level    
Rank 1:             1d3                               0                                        1
Rank 2:             1d4                               0                                        2
Rank 3:             1d4                               1                                        3 
Rank 4:             1d6                               1                                        4

Rank 9:             1d10                             3                                        9
                          1d12 *only possible with Master Weaver

spellcaster.name: Mana Font
spellcaster.description: Gain 1 extra mana /rank when generating mana.

guild.name: Formic Casting
guild.description: When transformed you may weave Red, Green and Black with sounds and gestures suited to your form. (Augmentation, Divination and Nature)

guild.name: Enduring Ghost
guild.description: Your Ghost Armor lasts one more hit.

guild.name: Smart Spells
guild.description: Your Discerning spells do not draw arcs. Instead they fail to materialize in circles or spheres just large enough to spare your allies.

guild.name: Totem Lag
guild.description: When you activate a second totem of the same size, the first does not turn off until your next turn.  The effects can overlap.

guild.name: Speedy Summon
guild.description: When you Summon Soulbound there is no delay.

divine.name: Divine Affinity
divine.prereq: Mark of Life, Light or Mischief
divine.description: Your Charisma is increased to match your highest attribute. Cannot be shared.

divine.name: Divine Armor
divine.prereq: Mark of Iron, War or Wisdom
divine.description: Your armor cannot be bypassed. This includes skills like armor piercing and spells like lightning bolt. Permanent passive

divine.name: Divine Guard
divine.prereq: Mark of Death, Iron, Life, Passion, Storms or War
divine.description: You are protected, increasing your Natural Armor by 5. Cannot Be Shared

divine.name: Divine Protection
divine.prereq: Mark of Death, Light, Mischief, Storms, War or Wisdom
divine.description: As a chosen favorite you are granted Immunity from Magical Fear, Mind Control, Charm, Sleep, and Paralysis. Chemical or other non magical versions of these affect you normally.

divine.name: Divine resilience
divine.prereq: Mark of Blood, Life, Light, Storms or Wisdom
divine.description: As a chosen favorite you are granted Immunity from mind control and charm. You can also be safely magically healed even when critical.

divine.name: Divine Transfer
divine.prereq: Mark of Blood, Death or Life
divine.description: You may move 2 Hit Points from your Torso to another body section for every action spent.

divine.name: Divine Repose
divine.prereq: Mark of Death, Iron or Wisdom
divine.description: You are immune to slowing effects and cold damage.

divine.name: Divine Appeal
divine.prereq: Mark of Mischief or Passion
divine.description: Any creature targeting you must pass a Willpower check equal to double your Charisma. (If shared through aura each affected ally's charisma is used for them.)

divine.name: Divine Auras
divine.prereq: Any Mark
divine.description: You learn to emanate power from your person.  The specific Aura determines the effects. The Aura extends for 30 Feet and costs 1 action to call and to maintain.  If two actions per turn are used the radius increases to 100 Feet.  If three actions per turn are used the radius is increased to 300 Feet. You may only learn 4 Auras, unless you receive a Mark of Favour at high level.

divine.name: Aura of Alacrity
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Iron, Mischief, Passion, Storms or Wisdom.
divine.description: +10 Initiative for all affected allies

divine.name: Aura of Ardour
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Mischief or Passion
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect that enhances any and all emotions present in affected creatures. This effect tends to accumulate.

divine.name: Aura of Blood
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Blood
divine.description: A pulsating, scarlet light. All wounded allies (less than full HP), gain +1 Crit on all melee attacks.

divine.name: Aura of Crafting
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Iron, Mischief, Passion or Wisdom
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect granting +10 to all skill checks made by affected creatures.

divine.name: Aura of Damping
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Iron, Life, or Wisdom
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect. All concentration costs by affected creatures are increased by (1).

divine.name: Aura of Death
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Death or War
divine.description: No healing can occur within the Aura.

divine.name: Aura of Despair
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Death, Iron, Life or Mischief
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect that adds disadvantage to all Willpower, Awareness and Charisma  checks made by non allies within the aura.

divine.name: Aura of Empathy
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Life, Passion or Wisdom
divine.description: A warm, orange tinted light emanates from you. You become aware of the the strongest emotion in every affected person, and how strong it is.

divine.name: Aura of Scattering
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of or Shaman Symbol  Iron, Storms or War
divine.description: All ranged attacks into, within or out of the Aura suffer an extra -4 penalty to hit.

divine.name: Aura of Focus
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Iron, Light, Passion, Storms War or Wisdom
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect that is strangely invigorating to you and your allies. +1 to the final combat or to hit roll. This can cause a melee critical or prevent a fumble, and increase Hit Surplus.

divine.name: Aura of Fortune
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Blood, Mischief, Passion or War
divine.description: Anyone moving into combat gains +1 crit on their damage rolls that turn. (Friend and Foe)

divine.name: Aura of Fury
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Blood, Mischief, Passion, Storms or War
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect that adds +5 to all Margins of Victory within the aura.

divine.name: Aura of Glory
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Light, Mischief, Passion War or Wisdom
divine.description: An subtle, audible effect. To all affected creatures your voice is richer, your tone pure, and is almost audible music underscoring your actions and speech. You gain +3 Charisma in the view of all affected sentient creatures.

divine.name: Aura of Growth
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Life
divine.description: One random affected ally gains 1 hit point each melee round and all (other) healing is increased by 1.

divine.name: Aura of Health
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Blood, Life, Light or Passion
divine.description: Adds advantage to all Strength, Constitution and Charisma  checks made by allies within the aura.

divine.name: Aura of Holy Wrath
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Light
divine.description: A harsh white light shines forth, excruciating the unholy. All affected Undead, Demonic and Evil creatures lose 1 action/round and take 1 Torso damage/round.

divine.name: Aura of Light
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Iron, Life, Light, Passion, Storms or Wisdom
divine.description: A bright warm white light shines forth all around you. All affected allies share the benefits of your Divine Defence.

divine.name: Aura of Pride
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Mischief or Wisdom
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect causes all Holy, Righteous and morally superior creatures lose 1 action/round. Any creature proud of itself, it's actions or it's endeavor will be affected.

divine.name: Aura of Rest
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Blood,Death, Life Mischief or Wisdom
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect that completes erases all fatigue from all effected creatures. Fatigue will begin to accrue normally when leaving the effect. Note that going without sleep will eventually have consequences other than fatigue.

divine.name: Aura of Shadows
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Blood, Death, Iron, Life, Mischief, Passion, War or Wisdom
divine.description: Light dims and shadows deepen around you. Advantage on all sneaking checks made within the aura and grants your Divine Defence to all affected allies

divine.name: Aura of Silence
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Iron, Light, Mischief, Shadow or Wisdom
divine.description: All sound is prevented within the aura.

divine.name: Aura of Spirit
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Death, Iron, Light, Mischief, War or Wisdom
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect that grants  a clarity of focus to you and your allies. Any Spells cast by affected allies gain +50% range or duration. (caster's choice.)

divine.name: Aura of Truth
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of or Shaman Symbol Death, Light, Mischief, Storms or Wisdom
divine.description: A pale light that dispels all illusions only so long as they are affected by the aura. Any Awarneess checks gain advantage.

divine.name: Aura of Vigilance
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark of Death, War or Wisdom
divine.description: An invisible, subtle effect. All affected allies cannot be surprised or flanked.

divine.name: Aura of Winds
divine.prereq:
Divine Auras
Mark or Shaman Symbol of Storms
divine.description: Wind is created or increased gradually over time, adding 1 mph every melee round, up to a maximum of one hundred mph. The size of aura chosen determines the type of effect. 1 action version moves air around the perimeter of the aura. The 2 action version moves air in the direction you are facing across the width of the aura. The three action version moves air at a steady 10mph upward in the whole area. Outdoors this will affect the weather for miles around. It takes 1 minute to change each category above the aura: Clear, some clouds,overcast,dark clouds, rain,rainstorm,thunderstorm. The surrounding area will be slower depending on distance. How quickly the new weather dissipates is situational and hard to predict.

divine.name: Exalted Auras
divine.prereq: Divine Auras
divine.description: Your Auras require 1 fewer action/round to maintain, but it still costs 1 action to change auras.

divine.name: Extended Auras
divine.prereq: Divine Auras
divine.description: Your Auras extend 50% farther. (usually 45 Feet, 150 Feet, 450 Feet.)

divine.name: Exalted Focus
divine.prereq: Aura of Focus
divine.description: Your Aura of Focus is improved. +2 to the final combat or to hit roll instead of +1.

divine.name: Bless
divine.prereq: Mark of Iron, Life, Light, Storms, War or Wisdom
divine.description: Target willing creature gains +1 on any die roll of their choice within 10 minutes. No creature can receive more than 1 blessing each day.  Costs 1 action per target.

divine.name: Curse
divine.prereq: Mark of Blood, Death, Iron, Passion or Wisdom
divine.description: Target creature suffers -2 on it's next die roll. No creature can be cursed more than once per day.

divine.name: Exhort
divine.prereq: Mark of Blood, Iron, Life, Mischief, Passion, Storms or Wisdom
divine.description: Target creature gains 1 action. No creature can be Exhorted more than once per day.

divine.name: Hallow
divine.prereq: Mark of Death, Life, Light, Mischief or Passion
divine.description: The next damage taken by target creature today will almost certainly (95%) be prevented by a twist of fate. You may only bestow this on a single creature, once a day. You may use it on yourself.

divine.name: Becalm
divine.prereq: Mark of Death, Light, War or Wisdom
divine.description: Target creature will pass their next Willpower check within 1 hour. No given creature can be Becalmed more than once/day.

divine.name: Exalted Benedictions
divine.prereq: Bless, Exhort or Hallow
divine.description: Your benedictions now also grants 1 point of healing.

divine.name: Prayer
divine.prereq:
Level 5 and
Bless, Exhort or Becalm
divine.description: Grants your Benediction to all Allies within 30 Feet who can hear it, even if they have already received it today. Costs 2 actions. Can only be used once per day.

divine.name: Exalted Prayer
divine.prereq: Prayer
divine.description: Your Prayer affects allies within 75 Feet

divine.name: Amplify curse
divine.prereq: Curse
divine.description: Your curses cause -4 instead of -2.

divine.name: Commune
divine.prereq: Level 5
divine.description: Meditate for 1-100 min, (you never know how long it will take). Ask your Deity a yes or no question. The GM will roll d20: On a roll of 3-20 the GM will tell you the real answer. On a roll of 2 the GM will always say No, and on a roll of 1 the GM will always say yes. (This gives the right answer 95% of the time) Repeated or excessive questions may anger your god.

divine.name: Dispel Evil
divine.prereq: Mark of Light or Passion or Wisdom
divine.description: Instigate a test of wills with target item or spellcaster using an unholy power. Roll a Willpower check and add your Arcane Power once for each action you spend focusing on this attempt in the turn. The Target does as well, if able. If successful an item is cleansed of all unholy power. An evil priest or spellcaster  is cut off from their unholy powers for a duration of 1 action per point they lost the contest by. Failure has no consequences for the caster. Curses are removed on a roll of 40 or higher.

divine.name: Dispel Magic
divine.prereq: Mark of Death, Iron, Light, or Wisdom
divine.description: Instigate a test of wills with target magical item or spellcaster. Roll a Willpower check and add your Arcane Power once for each action you spend focusing on this attempt in the turn. The Target does as well, if able. Success ends the effect or removes all magic from the item. Very powerful items will only be temporarily suppressed.

divine.name: Banish
divine.prereq: Marks Death, Storms, War or Wisdom
divine.description: Instigate a test of wills with a creature native to the following Planes: Astral,  Elemental, Outer or any Divine. Roll a Willpower check and add your Arcane Power once for each action you spend focusing on this attempt in the turn. The Target does as well, if able. The difference accrues as expulsion points. If the total expulsion points ever drops below zero the Banishment has failed. If they exceed the current total hit points from all body sections the Banishment suceeds and the target is returned instantly to their native plane. The contest continues until resolved, or the range is exceeded. Both paties choose each round how many actions to devote to the contest. A banished creature cannot return to the Prime Material Plane until 3 full moons have passed.

divine.name: Guided Wrath
divine.prereq: Mark or Shaman Symbol of Death, Iron, Light, Mischief, Passion, Storms, War or Wisdom
divine.description: Open yourself to Divine guidance in battle. Replace your Dexterity based Expertise bonus with your Willpower based Arcane Power in all combat situations. Also replace your Strength damage bonus with half of your Arcane Power.

divine.name: Prayer of Renewal
divine.prereq: Any Mark
divine.description: Meditate for 15 minutes. Restore all your daily divine ability uses. 1/week.

divine.name: Blood Rune
divine.prereq: Mark of Blood, Passion, War or Wisdom
divine.description: Tracing this glyph with the fresh blood of a living creature will heal 1 HP/round to the affected body section, and deal 2 Torso damage/round to the source of the blood.

divine.name: Grafting Glyph
divine.prereq: Mark of Iron, Mischief or Wisdom
divine.description: Tracing the Glyph on the skin of a creature with devotion will cause that Body section to Heal 1 HP/hour until it is fully healed. You lose 1d4 Torso HP when drawing the glyph. No creature can have more than one such Glyph at a time.

divine.name: Rain of Renewal
divine.prereq: Mark of Life, Light, Passion,Storms or Wisdom
divine.description: Gentle Rain falls in a 10 Foot radius circle around the caster, healing 1 hit point to all body section. Critical injuries are not affected. Can be used twice per day, at least two hours apart.

divine.name: Blade of shadow
divine.prereq: Mark of Death, Iron,Mischief, War or Wisdom
divine.description: A smoky melee weapon of whatever type the caster chooses appears and strikes a chosen target. Ranged Attack, roll to hit (2d10+your Dex based Expertise bonus). No penalties of any kind apply. Damage is 1d6+Dex based Ranged bonus.

divine.name: Blight/Smite
divine.prereq: Mark of Blood, Death, Life, Light or Passion
divine.description: Target Creature suffers 1d10 Torso Damage, bypassing artificial armor and shields. No bonuses apply, ever.

divine.name: Project
divine.prereq: Mark or Shaman Symbol of Mischief or Wisdom
divine.description: You appear to be two feet to the left, right, forward or rear of your actual position. The illusion is potent and will defeat most methods of detection, but not physical contact. Small differences such as footing on unlevel terrain are seamlessly corrected. Once established the direction does not change until concentration is released.

divine.name: Glyph of Union
divine.prereq: Mark of Iron, Mischief, Passion or Wisdom.
divine.description: You and target creature within 40 feet each roll a strength check, modified by relative size, elevation and anchorage. The loser is pulled to the winner provided there is a reasonably clear path.

divine.name: Kettle Vine
divine.prereq: Mark of Life or Mischief
divine.description: A nettlevine grows out of the ground and attempts to ensnare a chosen target. The creature must pass an awareness check 25 or be ensnared. Once ensnared a creature that attempts to move more than 3 feet must pass a Strength check 25 to break free.

divine.name: Spiritual Hammer
divine.prereq: Mark of Iron, Light, Storms, War or Wisdom
divine.description: Creates a translucent melee weapon of whatever type the caster chooses streaks towards the chosen target. Ranged Attack, roll do hit (2d10+your Arcane Power). No penalties of any kind apply and your Ranged Precision is 20. Damage is 1d6+your Arcane Power /2.

divine.name: Flash
divine.prereq: Mark of Light, Mischief or Storms
divine.description: You and your gear transform into a bolt of lightning and , move to a visible location with a direct open path at least 1 foot diameter, within 200 feet. The actual arrival location will scatter 10% of distance moved. If you would appear in solid matter the effect may fail, or scatter again.

divine.name: Consuming Kiss
divine.prereq: Mark of Mischief or Passion
divine.description: Place a 3 word compulsion upon a creature whose lips you touch with your own, such as "you love me", which colours all of their thinking for the duration unless they pass a Willpower check equal to double your charisma. Receptive or tempted creatures have disadvantage on the check

divine.name: Highlight
divine.prereq: Mark of War
divine.description: A pillar of bright light appears around target creature. All ranged attacks against that creature ignore all penalties. Cooldown: 4 hours.

divine.name: Exalted Offence
divine.prereq: Blade of Shadow, Blight/Smite, Glyph of Union, Kettle Vine or Spiritual Hammer
divine.description: Your Divine Offense gains 50% more range and +3 To Hit, Damage, and Ability checks, as applicable.

divine.name: Undertake Affliction
divine.prereq: Mark of Blood, Death, Life, Light, Passion, Storms or War.
divine.description: Cure disease, curse, blindness or even some corruption by taking it upon yourself.

divine.name: Enhanced Projection
divine.prereq: Project
divine.description: Your Projection range is increased to 15 feet, and you may stop it's movement while you move, at the cost of increased concentration. i.e: (2). Once you reduce back to cencentration (1) the project will maintain its distance and direction from you. If you exceed the range the projection will move with you, at max range.

divine.name: Mark of Favour
divine.prereq:
Level 15. 
Divine approval
divine.description: Must be granted by your Patron, usually after a vision quest. This unlocks skills below and also allows you to learn one more Aura.

divine.name: Aura of Purity.
divine.prereq:
Mark of Favour
Exalted Auras
Mark of Death, Iron, Light, War or Wisdom
divine.description: Prevents all active magic within range. The range is 50% of other auras and costs 1 more action /round than other auras.

divine.name: Ordination
divine.prereq: Mark of Favour
divine.description: Gain the power to bestow your Patron's Mark. You and the willing target must pray for at least 3 hours in a place of importance to you Deity. Both You and the target must pass a Willpower Check 25 or the ritual fails. That target may not attempt the ritual again for one year.

divine.name: Favoured Aura
divine.prereq: Mark of Favour Exalted Auras Extended Auras
divine.description: Choose one of the Auras you already know to designate as Favoured. That Aura no longer costs any actions. You may combine it with any other Aura you know. This does not alter the action cost of the other Aura.

divine.name: Glorious Hammer
divine.prereq: Mark of Favour. Exalted Hammer
divine.description: Your Spiritual Hammer range is increased to 125 Feet and the damage increased to 1d8+ your Arcane Power.

divine.name: Glorious Blessings
divine.prereq: Mark of favour Exalted blessings
divine.description: Your blessings now grant +1d4 instead of +1, and heals them for 3 hit points instead of 1.

divine.name: Champion's Choice
divine.prereq: Mark of Favour
divine.description: You may learn a second Divine Offence, or Divine Benediction, or Divine Defence.

divine.name: Champion's Charge
divine.prereq: Mark of Favour
divine.description: Your melee is resolved first in the combat round. If you end that melee out of combat you may move to join another within half of your maximum movement. You may participate in the second melee, with 2 free actions as well as any saved. Under no circumstances can you join a third melee.

balance.name: Studious Dedication
balance.description: Dedication to the monastic creed of humility, self improvement, and diligence. You may not use any weapons or wear any armor in combat. Every level you must spend at least 5 points on the Inner Focus general skill until it reaches the limit. This is the source of your mystical power. Only through the hard work of self improvement can it be fully realized. As long as this discipline is maintained you gain 1 action every round for every 6 full levels.

balance.name: Concussive Blow
balance.description: Special Attack. The attack bypasses 3 armor /rank. The damage is delayed until the start of next round's combat phase.

balance.name: Numbing Blow
balance.description: Special Attack:  Drive your essence into the target's pressure points, numbing the area instead of dealing damage. This penetrates most armor but not shields. The effect of the blow depends on the location hit. Limbs are disabled for 2 rounds with no save. Blows to the Torso stun the target for 1 round unless they pass a Constitution Check 25. Blows to the head  stun the target for 1 round unless they pass a Willpower Check 25.

balance.name: Chi Shield
balance.description: You have a Chi Shield of 1 HP/rank, which is applied before any critical damage. It regenerates 1 HP/hour. Alternatively, The Chi Shield can be used to counter magical damage before any Hit Points are lost, absorbing 1d6/point per point of Chi Shield used.

balance.name: Wind's Whisper
balance.description: Recieve the guidance of the wind, increasing your Precision and Evasion by 1/rank.    Total Precision can never exceed 25. Total Evasion can never exceed 20.

balance.name: Enlightened Focus
balance.description:
You can cure yourself of fear and paralysis by passing an instant Inner focus check (1 action) .
You can cure yourself of disease and poison by raising your Constitution with Inner Focus. You can rid yourself of Charm and Curse effects by raising your WP with Inner Focus, even if the effect would normally stop you from attempting to remove it.
All of these require a successful skill roll.

balance.name: Mystic Strikes
balance.description: Your unarmed strikes count as magical.

balance.name: Wind Stance
balance.description:
+1 foot/ action and +1 Evasion /rank, -1 Penalty to all ranged attacks aginst you /2ranks, as well as the abilities shown below, while using this stance. 
Rank 3: You can wall jump double the height of your normal jump. 
Rank 6: You can run along walls for short distances. 
Rank 9: You can now run on water for short distances.

balance.name: Wave Stance
balance.description: +1 Expertise, +1 Precision and +1 on all Dexterity checks /rank while using this stance.

balance.name: Stone Stance
balance.description: +1 Damage and +1 on all Strength checks /rank while using this stance.

balance.name: Flame Stance
balance.description: Your Chi Shield has double the effect (2HP or 2d6 /point), and you gain advantage on all Constitution and Willpower checks while using this stance.

balance.name: Stance Dancing
balance.description: reduces the action cost of switching stances from1 to 0. You cannot change stances twice in the same melee round.

infernal.name: Demonic Contract
infernal.description: Form an unholy pact with a Demon, trusting in your strength of will to resist corruption.

infernal.name: Demonic Control
infernal.description: Automatically pass any Willpower Check at the cost of 1 Corruption.

infernal.name: Demonic servant
infernal.description: An imp one quarter of your level appears within 10 feet. It will follow your commands, mostly, for one minute. After that it is free of all control and loose upon the Material Plane.  1/week for each rank.

infernal.name: Red Haze
infernal.description: Gain 1 Action and 1 Corruption in the round following every kill you make with reckless attacks.

infernal.name: Blue Haze
infernal.description: Jump up 10 Initiative in the round following every kill you make with reckless attacks.

infernal.name: Blood Haze
infernal.description: Heal 2 HP  in the round following every kill you make with reckless attacks.

infernal.name: Cursed Bow
infernal.prereq:
Demonic Contract
Cannot have 
Cursed Blade
infernal.description:
Target Bow or Crossbow becomes cursed, and linked to the caster, granting increasing benefits with rank.
Rank   To Hit bonus   RangedPR        Other Effects
  1                0                 1                 Self Repairing.
  2                1                 2                 Always know it's direction.
  3                1                 3                 Summon the weapon 1/week (9 actions)
  4                2                 4                 HSAP increased by 0.25
  5                2                 5                 Causes Breeches (1)
  6                3                 6                Self Reloading with Shadow Bolts
Shadow Bolts are magical projectiles that do the same damage as a normal physical arrow. This removes the action cost of reloading crossbows.

infernal.name: Cursed Blade
infernal.prereq:
Demonic Contract
Cannot have 
Cursed Bow
infernal.description:
Target Melee Weapon becomes cursed, and linked to the caster, granting increasing benefits with rank.
Rank           AP           PR        Other Effects
  1                1              1           1 damage/r to anyone else grasping it.
  2                2              2           Always know it's direction.
  3                3              3           Summon the weapon 1/week (9 actions)
  4                4              4           Melee Crit number reduced by 1
  5                5              5           Every wound caused heals you 1HP
  6                6              6           You can hear what it hears.
All of these Benefits apply if the weapon is Thrown.

infernal.name: Cursed Touch
infernal.description: touch spells you cast affect your cursed weapon instead of your hand, and are triggered on pierce. Does not combine with cursed bow or crossbow.

infernal.name: Chill
infernal.description:
Costs 1 action which does not count towards combat. Pierce. Victim feels an icy chill spreading from the wound.They can feel their strength draining…
They must pass a Willpower Check 25 or be Feared. Willpower 21 or 1 Corruption

infernal.name: Gasp
infernal.description:
Costs 1 action which does not count towards combat. Pierce. Victim feels they cannot breathe, fights for air. They must pass a Willpower Check 25 or lose their next 3 actions. 
Willpower 21 or 1 Corruption

infernal.name: Taste
infernal.description:
Costs 1 action which does not count towards combat. Pierce. You allow the cursed weapon to taste the life force of the target, and drink. Deals 1 necrotic damage/rank of Cursed Blade on this weapon. 
Willpower 21 or 1 Corruption

infernal.name: A Stronger You
infernal.description: Gain 1 point of Strength at the cost of 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Willpower. (Juicing works! We promise.)

infernal.name: A Cooler You
infernal.description: Gain 1 point of Charisma at the cost of 1 point of Dexterity and 1 point of Willpower. (Yeah it's uncomfortable, but you look amazing! We promise.)

infernal.name: A Faster You
infernal.description: Gain 1 point of Dexterity at the cost of 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Willpower. (This stuff feels awesome AND helps you perform. We promise.)

infernal.name: A Brighter You
infernal.description: Gain 1 point of Awareness at the cost of 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Willpower. (It's a lot like snuff, you'll love it! We promise.)

infernal.name: A Better You
infernal.description: Gain 50 Skill Points at the cost of 1 point of Willpower, which can only be spent on this page              (No Backsies!)

infernal.name: Demonic Hex
infernal.description: Gain the ability to Hex a target within 30 feet. The particular Hex determines the effect. Hexes are done using borrowed actions, as an interruption of an activity. All hexes cost 1 action to cast, which must be repaid before any other actions. Willpower 25 Check to avoid 1 Corruption

infernal.name: Hextastic.
infernal.description: Increase the range of your Hexes to 90 Feet.

infernal.name: Stumble
infernal.description: Hex, target who is running or sprinting must pass. Dexterity Check 25 or fall down.

infernal.name: Mumble
infernal.description: Hex. Target who is speaking must pass a Charisma Check 25 or use exactly the wrong word.

infernal.name: Fumble
infernal.description: Hex, target who is in combat Fumbles on a roll 2 higher than normal.

infernal.name: Nudge
infernal.description: Hex,the target's current ranged to hit roll is reduced by 2

infernal.name: Wince
infernal.description: A sharp twinge distracts the target momentarily unless they pass a WP Check 25.

infernal.name: Wither
infernal.description: Sickens plants or seeds over 1d10 days

infernal.name: Bicker
infernal.description: Target angry person has disadvantage on all restraint checks.

infernal.name: Beckon
infernal.description: Target person feeling strong lust has disadvantage on all restraint checks.

infernal.name: Demonic Surge
infernal.description: Gain 3 actions right now, and lose one action each of the next three turns. These can be delayed by passing a constitution check 25 each round. If the check is fumbled or is less than 15 all owed actions must be paid immediately.  Willpower 21 or 1 Corruption

infernal.name: Summon Nightmare
infernal.description: A Flaming Nightmare  appears in a clear space at least 15 Feet diameter. It is saddled, bridled and has 2 empty saddlebags. It will only suffer the caster to ride. The caster gains +20 riding and immunity to fire while riding.

infernal.name: Surgical
infernal.description: Your Demonic surge grants one extra action which does not need to be repaid.

infernal.name: HellStep
infernal.description: Step into the abyss and back, arriving wherever your weapon is. Costs one action and adds 1 Corruption.

lycanthropy.name: Werewolf
lycanthropy.description:
The effects depend on the phase of the Lunar cycle.
Most of the time (phase 1) you heal +1hp /day, without any other effects. 
Within 3 days of the Full moon, including the full moon night itself, (phase 2, 7 days total) you heal +1hp in every location every 8 hours. You also gain +1 Strength, a natural armor rating of 1, and suffer a -2 penalty to all Willpower checks.
When the moon rises on the night of the Full Moon, (phase 3) you must pass a Willpower Check 30 (after penalty) or lose control and transform. While transformed you gain a further + 2 strength and 2 more natural armor rating, and heal 1 hp/minute. You also become immune to weapons unless they are silver or magical.

lycanthropy.name: Contain the Wolf
lycanthropy.description: Reduce the difficulty of the Willpower Check to maintain control of full moon nights by 5/rank.

lycanthropy.name: The Wolf Within
lycanthropy.description:
Rank 1: Phase 2 starts 6 days before the full moon and ends 6 days afterwards instead of 3. (13 days instead of 7)
Rank 2: Phase 2 starts 10 days before the full moon and ends 10 days afterwards. (21 days)
Rank 3: Phase 2 effects apply all the time.

lycanthropy.name: Embrace the Wolf
lycanthropy.description:
Rank 1: The Willpower Check on full moon nights does not prevent transformation. Instead, if passed, you remain aware of yourself and may attempt to resist any specific action, with a Willpower Check 25. You may undertake an action not natural to the wolf on a similar check.
Rank 2: You will transform when provoked enough any time in phase 2. (rage or pain)
Rank 3: When transformed you are in complete control of your actions, subject to Willpower Checks when the GM feels an action is very tempting to the wolf.
Rank 4: You may transform at will anytime in phase 2.

lycanthropy.name: BeastForm
lycanthropy.description: When you transform for any reason you retain your gross shape and size. Your teeth, claws and hair lengthen, and your irises become red. Your clothing, armor, helm and equipment still fit, and you can still wield weapons. You do not gain the special movement or attacks of the wolf form, and you do not become immune to normal weapons. You regenerate 1 hp /hour.  You gain a total +2 Strength and Natural Armor, instead of +3.

lycanthropy.name: Rabid run down
lycanthropy.prereq: Must be in beast form or wolf form.
lycanthropy.description: You allow the beast within complete control to pursue a chosen target. You will move up to 75 Feet per round, including leaping gaps of no more than 30 Feet until you reach the target or lose sight of it. Upon reaching the target you must perform a reckless attack immediately and continue until it is dead or you pass a WP Check 30
